## P4 contract reality continuation — Owner decisions pending, not applied

`P4_BLOCKER_RESOLUTION_RESULT=OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED_BLOCKED`
`PHASE_EXIT_AUDIT=INCOMPLETE` (existing independent audit retained; no actual gate newly ready)
`PRODUCTION_OWNER_GATE=NOT_READY`

MAIN reconciled four read-only `gpt-6-luna`/`max` streams: official tooling, credential/RBAC, actual readiness, and independent security/contract challenge. No confirmed supported tooling improvement or source defect justifies changing #133. Main stays `c79659046cf6ea73ba69e03c3937d904c07ba93b`; #133 remains OPEN/unmerged at `30ed167ed57e18de0308e7ba1e0c9d0e70ab7570`.

Two remaining blocker classes, with one concrete proposal each:

- **Tooling — [T1 full proposal and evidence](https://github.com/markd3ng/KIRARI/issues/130#issuecomment-5996717676).** Latest stable CLI remains 62.2.0; its retained exact audit still has 33 aggregate affected-package entries (8 moderate/24 high/1 critical). Active 59.16.0 and exact-head CI remain failed. Native remains experimental; documented SDK/REST does not establish the complete immutable stage-without-alias flow. T1 proposes exact-version/runtime/platform/integrity/advisory manifest + full unsuppressed FAIL inventory + independent security review + finite explicit Owner risk acceptance. UNKNOWN reachability/bundled provenance gaps and coupled credential-process risk remain exposed. No version/advisory/policy amendment is approved.
- **Platform/Owner readiness — [C1 full proposal and exact setup/readback checklist](https://github.com/markd3ng/KIRARI/issues/129#issuecomment-5996720224).** Public stable PAT/CLI roles support exact Project resource scope, not the required exact-verb-only credential. Proposed candidate: one-project PAT, Team Developer plus only Full Production Deployment, with all direct/group elevation excluded. Additional project/domain/dev-preview-variable/other-deployment capabilities are disclosed; actual principal/plan/grants/scope/expiry require read-only proof and concrete Owner acceptance. Dedicated environment remains absent; credential name/scope unverified; authenticated Trusted Sources and provider Git setting remain UNKNOWN. Do not infer the CI boolean semantics or manually set an undocumented flag to force parser match. No setup or policy mutation was performed.

The canonical-compatible artifact is already VERIFIED and is **not a blocker**: source #134 at `b1b488ce9491c75718a32cbcf06351d908204358`, build-only run `37258535783`, package `11323926470` / `sha256:21c27932ae527b81afe5cc19ec6b163da6dfd11e455b210f594a211e04ced7cd`, composition `11324140696` / `sha256:29d0f4da56ab01fdf5e6ec3dc6e598df591a9ef201eef7cbb00aad2c9658efab`. No rebuild/retest/deployment was performed this round. Prior Chromium/byte/canonical acceptance remains applicable.

Unchanged source means prior P4 90/90, selected P3/CI 29/29, 18 root checks, actual Production Chromium PASS and independent exact-head code review are reused, not relabeled fresh. [Exact-head CI 37280337916](https://github.com/markd3ng/KIRARI/actions/runs/37280337916) remains FAIL only at deployment audit. Source main Git guard remains PASS; provider setting readback UNKNOWN. Legacy Production dpl_7ACbEGqeC8f7yyqZqmAjzL78F5sB still has UNKNOWN provenance and is not an approved rollback record.

Independent proposal challenge found T1/C1 defensible to **propose**, incorporated finite expiry, exact runner/runtime/install binding and human-readable advisory inventory, and found no confirmed code defect. This is neither policy acceptance nor a new Phase Exit Audit. [Existing Phase Exit Audit](https://github.com/markd3ng/KIRARI/issues/99#issuecomment-5990740520) remains INCOMPLETE; [existing exact-head COMMENT review](https://github.com/markd3ng/KIRARI/pull/133#pullrequestreview-5411612179) is not human merge approval.

#99 OPEN/Blocked; #129 OPEN/In Review; #130 OPEN/Blocked; #131 CLOSED/Done for local-browser engineering only; #132 CLOSED/Done for rollback simulation only. P3 stays complete; no duplicate Issues or scope drift. Project README reconciled to these two remaining blocker classes. No Production phrase was issued/consumed. No deploy/promote/alias/settings/secret/rollback/DNS/indexing/release/tag/P5/Gateway action.

**Next action:** Owner decides T1 and C1 separately. Acceptance is only a contract-policy decision; concrete version/grant manifests, implementation validation if needed, actual protected setup/readback and any future Production authorization remain separate gates. Until explicit acceptance, original criteria remain effective and P4 stays Blocked.
